notes: FirstSeen Desktop V10.2.13 bundles Browser CRM V2.8. Business summaries are more detailed, using richer service descriptions, service-area context and website-presence context. Existing V10.2.12 auto-generated summaries are upgraded automatically while manually edited summaries are preserved. New leads receive the richer summary format automatically. To use review information conservatively, FirstSeen shows a separate live Google Maps review snapshot with the aggregate star rating and review count plus a source link when available; raw Google review text is not copied into or stored in FirstSeen summaries. Existing Twilio browser calling, editable call scripts, outcomes, follow-ups, Finder shortlist, SQLite CRM data and updater behaviour are preserved.
